# get_default_colors { #mofography.visualize.get_default_colors }

```python
visualize.get_default_colors()
```

[summary]
Uses the ASE's jmol colorscheme as the default for plotting the atoms.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                               | Description                                                                            |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \[(N,3) numpy array of floats all within \[0,1\]\] | [Normalized rgb values of the jmol colorscheme as included within ASE python module. ] |
